name: php-operator-assist
description: Use a dot for PHP object and static access operators: -> and ::.

phpDotToArrow.enabled.description: Convert a dot typed after a PHP object or class expression into -> or ::.

phpDotToArrow.onlyWithoutWhitespace.description: Only convert when the dot is immediately next to the expression. This helps preserve spaced string concatenation such as $a . $b.
